caption: The drawing depicts detailed designs of a brooch and an earring, shown with both frontal and side elevations. The brooch, which is oval-shaped, features an arrangement of alternating stones: a central pinkish-purple faceted gem with an internal gold floral motif, surrounded by a ring of pearly white circular stones, and an outer ring of similarly colored purple oval stones, all set in a gold-colored framework. The side view displays the brooch's layered structure and the arrangement of the stones. The earring is illustrated as a dangling piece with a floral-shaped purple stone at the top, connected by a thin gold section interspersed with a small white stone and a hexagonal purple gem. The main drop of the earring mirrors the brooch's central gem: a large, teardrop-shaped purple stone featuring a golden floral design set near its base, capped with a gold-colored element. The earring’s side view shows a screw back closure. Handwritten notes on the drawing include labels for the side elevations and a notation stating "EAR RING AND BROOCH TWICE ACTUAL SIZE" along with the designer's name, "R. ELVIS." The drawing is executed on an off-white or cream background, and the colors used are primarily shades of purple, gold, and white.
title: Brooch and Earrings
